subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 6 — Tree Topologies, Binary Traversals & Binary Search Trees
moduleDescription: Comprehensive study of hierarchical non-linear data structures: Tree formal terminology, First-Child/Next-Sibling N-ary representations, binary tree structural classifications, Depth-First (DFS) and Breadth-First (BFS) traversals, recursive vs iterative stack-driven visiting engines, Binary Search Tree (BST) mutations (search, insert, deletion by merging vs copying), and self-balancing AVL rotation fundamentals.
